look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Check for simple, alternate, broadly obovate leaves (widest beyond the middle) with mostly entire margins and a rounded tip. In flower or fruit season, seek large loose panicles with many fine elongated hairy stalks that create the characteristic smoke-like effect. The staged photograph shows foliage, not a diagnostic flowering panicle.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Deciduous shrub or small tree, often with a rounded crown; older bark can become textured.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Leaves alternate, simple, broad and usually obovate to rounded, widest above the midpoint; margins mostly entire and petioles slender; fall color often orange to red but not an identification key alone.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Small flowers in large, loose, branching terminal panicles; many flower stalks elongate and develop fine hairs, producing a diffuse smoky appearance.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Small dry drupe-like fruits borne on panicles; examine mature fruit and persistent hairy pedicels with a macro image.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Woody branchlets with alternate buds and leaf scars; verify bark and twig details from a close view rather than foliage color.
